en: Sepia-toned interior view of a well-furnished sitting room with multiple wooden armchairs, small round tables with cloths, houseplants and vases of flowers, large windows with curtains, a standing lamp, and decorative plates on a shelf. The caption at the bottom identifies the room as the sitting room of 'de Sonnaville Rusthuis' in Hees, near Nijmegen, and credits the architect Cor. Roffelsen of Helmond.
